about.title: About Us
about.subtitle: Manufacturers of Harvesters, Choppers and Agricultural Implements in Peru
about.historyText: FSI Implementos Agrícolas is a Peruvian company specialized in manufacturing potato harvesters, agricultural choppers, brush cutters and field implements. We were born as a response to the need of all farmers and agro-industrial companies in the country to make the farmer's task easier and accomplish it in less time. Over 30 years of experience manufacturing harvesters, choppers, machinery and agricultural implements for the Peruvian countryside at the best prices. F.S.I SAC develops, innovates, and manufactures harvesters, choppers, brush cutters and agricultural machinery for tractors in Peru.
about.missionText: To provide the highest quality agricultural implements that improve the efficiency and productivity of our clients, contributing to the development of the agricultural sector.

services.fabricationDesc: We manufacture custom agricultural implements, adapted to each client's specific needs.

products.title: Our Products
products.description: We have a wide range of potato harvesters, agricultural choppers, potato leaf brush cutters, cultivators, fertilizer spreaders and other equipment designed for the Peruvian agricultural sector. Each harvester, chopper and implement is carefully manufactured to ensure optimal performance and a long service life, even in demanding terrain. We are direct manufacturers in Peru.

video1.title: Integral Bed Shaper - FSI Agricultural Implements El Iqueño SAC - Peru
video1.description: Integral Bed Shaper for forming uniform agricultural beds in crops like potatoes and sweet potatoes. Optimizes soil preparation, improving planting and irrigation. Manufactured by FSI Agricultural Implements El Iqueño SAC - Peruvian quality and efficiency.

video2.title: Potato and Sweet Potato Leaf Shredder/Brush Cutter with chain (new) - FSI SAC-EL IQUEÑO - PERU
video2.description: Ideal for crop cleaning, it quickly removes plant residues, improving field management. Designed by FSI SAC - EL IQUEÑO, Peruvian quality for efficient agricultural work.

video3.title: Potato and Sweet Potato Harvester - FSI SAC EL IQUEÑO - PERU
video3.description: Specialized harvester for potatoes and sweet potatoes, ideal for speeding up your harvest. Extracts tubers without damaging them and efficiently separates them from the soil. Increases your productivity and reduces manual labor in the field.

video4.title: Corn Stover Chopper - FSI SAC EL IQUEÑO - PERU
video4.description: The corn stover chopper is a machine designed to shred agricultural residues such as corn stover, making it easier to use as livestock feed or compost. Its robust structure and cutting efficiency optimize fieldwork.

video5.title: Cultivator-Fertilizer Spreader with hydraulic system - FSI SAC EL IQUEÑO - PERU
video5.description: Versatile agricultural tool that allows tilling the soil and applying fertilizer simultaneously. Thanks to its hydraulic system, it offers greater precision and ease of use. Ideal for improving soil fertility and optimizing cultivation. Designed to increase efficiency and reduce effort in agricultural work.
